units.source_text: 以前，从接触到那双美丽的腿而成为没有性功能的时候起，

en.t: Before, from the moment I touched those beautiful legs and became sexually impotent,

units.source_text: 我就觉得自己对欲望产生了一种误解。

en.t: I felt that I had developed a kind of misunderstanding about desire.

units.source_text: 因为这时候，处在这种丑恶的膜拜的最高潮，我察觉自己很亢奋。

en.t: Because at that moment, at the height of this ugly worship, I realized that I was deeply excited.

units.source_text: 在对自己没有丝毫幻想的情况下！

en.t: While having not the slightest illusion about myself!

units.source_text: 在这种最不可宽恕的状态下！
